source_bindings.finding: close_session rejects result_ref/result_sha256 only when there is no commit-eligible output; once at least one fully heard completed output exists it constructs VoiceOutcome from the caller-supplied result pair and attaches the outcome id to all commit-eligible output packets without proving result_sha256 equals any output packet/text/aggregate digest.

VoiceOutcome is explicitly identity/provenance-only. Its contract validates result_ref/result_sha256 pair presence, syntax and outcome identity, but does not and cannot prove that the result bytes are the fully heard voice output.

existing_test_observation.finding: Current tests intentionally demonstrate evidence-only semantics: after a completed/heard output, close_session is accepted with caller-selected result_ref values and synthetic fixed result_sha256 values such as repeated 'b' or 'd' hex. This is not a defect in WP704/WP715 scope; it is a required fail-closed boundary for the new integration consumer.

risk.statement: If a State/Memory/Context integration adapter treats VoiceOutcome.result_ref/result_sha256 as proof of what the user actually heard, arbitrary caller-supplied result content can be promoted merely because some output in the session was commit-eligible.

require: Bind the exact VoiceSessionCapsule and VoiceOutcome identities.
Bind the exact ordered set of fully heard commit-eligible VoiceOutputPacket identities and packet SHA256 values used to construct the next-turn/durable result payload.
Construct or receive one explicit heard-result payload identity whose SHA256 is derived from the exact selected fully heard content/aggregate under a deterministic canonicalization rule.

If VoiceOutcome.result_ref/result_sha256 is consumed as the heard result, require it to match that exact heard-result payload identity; opaque/synthetic/unrelated result pairs remain evidence-only and are not memory/context/state authority.
For multiple completed output segments, bind deterministic sequence order and reject omission, duplication or reordering before deriving the aggregate heard-result digest.
Carry the existing ContextCostWitness requirement for any heard-result ContextItem selected into ContextView.
Interrupted output remains non-commit-eligible and must not mint a durable VoiceOutcome result merely because a prefix was heard.
The measured heard-prefix stays a separate ephemeral payload identity with its own exact digest and ContextCostWitness; unheard tail remains excluded.

smallest_discriminators.setup: One completed output, heard_fraction=1.0, exact packet/text payload aggregate and matching result_ref/result_sha256.
smallest_discriminators.expect: integration adapter admits the exact binding at component-integration scope only

smallest_discriminators.setup: Same fully heard output but VoiceOutcome carries a different otherwise-valid 64-hex result_sha256.
smallest_discriminators.expect: WP704/WP715 evidence object may remain structurally valid, but the state/memory/context integration adapter rejects promotion as UNBOUND_VOICEOUTCOME_RESULT

smallest_discriminators.setup: Two fully heard completed output segments with exact sequence 0,1; candidate result aggregate swaps, omits or duplicates one segment.
smallest_discriminators.expect: integration adapter rejects before memory/context/state admission
prefix may enter ephemeral next-turn context only with exact prefix digest + cost witness; no durable VoiceOutcome result/memory/effect authority

next_exact_action: Trigger4 consumes this addendum inside the existing VSR01-VSR06 integration boundary. Do not change accepted WP704/WP715 semantics merely to make the old evidence contracts stronger. In the smallest external adapter/harness, bind VoiceOutcome to the exact ordered fully heard output payload before any state/memory/context promotion, carry the ContextCostWitness for selected context, execute the positive and adversarial VSR01/VSR02 discriminators on the proven VPS route, and promote only the exact component-integration evidence measured.
